# Generated by houston. Do not edit by hand -- re-run `houston up`.
name: houston-t
services:
  rocketchat:
    image: registry.rocket.chat/rocketchat/rocket.chat:8.4.1
    restart: always
    environment:
      ROOT_URL: http://localhost:3000
      PORT: '3000'
      DEPLOY_METHOD: docker
      DEPLOY_PLATFORM: compose
      MONGO_URL: mongodb://mongodb:27017/rocketchat?replicaSet=rs0
      ALLOW_UNSAFE_QUERY_AND_FIELDS_API_PARAMS: 'true'
      OVERWRITE_SETTING_Show_Setup_Wizard: completed
      ADMIN_USERNAME: admin
      ADMIN_NAME: Admin
      ADMIN_EMAIL: admin@example.com
      ADMIN_PASS: admin123
      FLAG: 'True'
      NO_WORD: 'False'
      NOTHING: None
      BIG: '12345678901234567890'
      NEG_BIG: '-12345678901234567890'
      SAFE: '42'
      FLOAT: '1.0'
      FRACTION: '2.5'
      EXP: '1e+20'
      INF: inf
      NAN: nan
      DATE: '2026-01-01'
      STAMP: '2026-01-01 10:00:00'
      STAMP_OFFSET: '2026-01-01 10:00:00.500000+05:30'
      NESTED: '{''a'': 1, 1: ''b'', ''f'': 1.0}'
      LIST: '[1, 2, ''x'', 1.0, None, True, datetime.date(2026, 1, 1)]'
      EMPTY: '[]'
      PLAIN: text
      QUOTED: '3.0'
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:3000:3000
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - node
      - -e
      - require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/api/info',r=>process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 60s
    depends_on:
      mongo-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
  mongodb-fix-permission:
    image: docker.io/mongodb/mongodb-community-server:8.0-ubi8
    user: '0'
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
    - mongodb_data:/data/db:rw
    entrypoint:
    - sh
    - -c
    - chown -R 1001 /data/db
  mongodb:
    image: docker.io/mongodb/mongodb-community-server:8.0-ubi8
    user: '1001'
    restart: always
    ulimits:
      nofile:
        soft: 64000
        hard: 64000
    depends_on:
      mongodb-fix-permission:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    volumes:
    - mongodb_data:/data/db:rw
    entrypoint:
    - mongod
    - --replSet
    - rs0
    - --bind_ip_all
    environment:
      ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD: 'yes'
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - mongosh
      - mongodb://mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
      - --eval
      - db.adminCommand('ping')
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 20s
  mongo-init:
    image: docker.io/mongodb/mongodb-community-server:8.0-ubi8
    restart: 'no'
    depends_on:
      mongodb:
        condition: service_healthy
    entrypoint:
    - mongosh
    - mongodb://mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    - --eval
    - 'try { rs.status() } catch (e) { rs.initiate({ _id: ''rs0'', members: [{ _id:
      0, host: ''mongodb:27017'' }] }) }'
volumes:
  mongodb_data:
    driver: local

airgapped.name: airgapped
airgapped.description: Simulates an air-gapped workspace with no Rocket.Chat Cloud connectivity. The Cloud URL and workspace credentials point at non-routable placeholders, so cloud sync, registration and marketplace calls never reach out. Use to reproduce offline / disconnected-workspace behaviour.

default.name: default
default.description: Vanilla Rocket.Chat, ready to use immediately: setup wizard skipped and an admin user auto-created (admin / admin123).

email.name: email
email.description: Mailpit mailcatcher wired to RC's SMTP. Every email RC sends — password resets, invites, verification, notification and 2FA mail — is captured at http://localhost:8025 instead of leaving the machine. Pair with --seed for users with verified emails.

params_help.verification: require email verification on new accounts (default false)

notes: Mailpit (EVERY email RC sends, for ALL users, lands here): http://localhost:8025
— one shared inbox; tell users apart by the To: column.
Quick SMTP check: Admin → Email → 'Send test email', then open Mailpit.
Email-2FA is ON globally, but RC only enforces it on VERIFIED emails:
seeded users (alice/…) get the OTP flow (code in Mailpit); admin is
unverified so it logs in plain. houston's own token/api/seed calls
fetch any required code from Mailpit automatically.
Seeded users (--seed) are created with verified emails, ready for 2FA.

kind: Deployment
metadata:

  labels: &id001
    app: houston-mailpit
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: houston
    houston.io/component: mailpit
    houston.io/repro: __HOUSTON_NAME__
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: houston-mailpit
